Value Proposition Manager Wealth – Private Banking
ING Private Banking is on an ambitious growth journey. As the market leader in the business segment, we see tremendous potential to expand our footprint in the Private Banking space in Belgium.
To support this growth, we are strengthening our central teams and launching a dedicatedWealth Officewithin ING Private Banking. This office will focus on clients withfinancial capital exceeding €5M, most of which is typically invested. These clients expect not only top-tier investment services but alsocomprehensive financial and estate planning,Next Gen advisory, and tailored solutions indaily banking, insurance, and lending.
You’ll join a high-performing team of experts committed to delivering a best-in-class experience for our Wealth clients.
Your Role: Value Proposition Manager Wealth
As Value Proposition Manager Wealth (GJA 18), you will be responsible for designing and delivering a compelling and competitive offering for our Wealth clients. You will:
Develop and implement strategic initiativesthat enhance our Wealth value proposition, keeping pace with market trends and client expectations.
